reviews.comment: Prof Arnosky was kind, and a good teacher even with her personal issues and how tough acct 229 is. However, Acct 229 is a class hand picked by the devil.

Good professor despite her going through several personal family matters over the semester. Class isn't too bad as long as you use every resource provided to you and study a week out before each exam. Never ended up going to any SI sessions but did the problems from home. Overall a meritocratic class where you'll get the A if you put in the work

Arnosky is not bad - ACCT 229 is already a very hard course to begin with, and I think she did a good job teaching. I didn't go to SI sessions but constantly did practice through posted problems on canvas + SI website to study. 3 tests, 7 out of 10 best quiz scores, 1 group project, and final are all the grades in the class.

ACCT 229 has definitely lived up to the expectation of being a difficult class. Highly recommended studying at least a few days in advance. If you cram the day before, you will not pass. Arnosky is a kind prof, but you'll likely have the same experience in this class regardless of who you take.There's 1 group project that can boost your grade.

ACCT 229 is bad, no matter who you take it with. Arnosky is definitely better than other profs, but if you can, take Knope. PLEASE go to the Help Desk and SI Sessions, it'll help a lot. Start studying days in advance, ask her lots of questions, and DO NOT SKIP CLASS. Very willing to help and decent prof, its just an horrid class.

TAKE HER. She is so nice and actually wants you to ask questions. 10/10. There are 3 tests plus the final, you have to study A LOT for this class in general, but I would say Arnosky is def one of the best. Take-home quizzes easy; attendance is not mandatory, but you won't pass if you don't go. So good.

Well she didn't round me up to an A when I was one question missed away from being there. If you can, get Knoop. Arnosky is doable, but if you want to succeed well, go to all the SI (Supplement Instruction) sessions that they tell you about first day of class. On top of that, you can get the correct answers for hw at the help desk
Wouldn't round my grade :/ I hate how TAMU has those rules about rounding.

No matter who you take this course has been proven to be quite difficult. Arnosky is very caring (ask her for help if you need it) knowledgable and is very experienced in her field. You must study a minimum of a week before tests to study effectively. I didn't show up to SI and I still got an above average grade. Just study study study.

Regardless of which professor you have, ACCT 229 is hard but they all have the same tests and grading system. However, Arnosky is a very good professor and she tries hard to help you understand the material.

Going into taking 229, I was so scared. I had only heard bad things. I'm here to say it was not that bad at all. The class is very test heavy, so you should start studying about a week out in advance to be prepared. I also think attending SI sessions weekly helped me a lot. An A is definitely attainable, and I ended up getting a 97.5 on the final

I needed a specific grade on the final to be able to get a C. I was a few points below the cutoff and she granted me a C out of the kindness of her heart. Wouldn't be able to register for 4/5 of my classes for the fall without that C. I lover her. I hope she never faces any inconveniences. No matter the professor, 229 is hard. STUDY.

She's very nice, and it seems like she wants students to grasp the knowledge. I found myself confused every lecture and though she asks the class for questions, it's almost like she can never answer them to full capacity. There are few assignments and the overall grade are the tests, which are also extremely difficult. Take it at cc if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Arnosky does a great job teaching a hard class. She's very approachable and easy to communicate with. People struggle in this class, however, that's not because of her. Stay on top of content, READ THE TEXTBOOK, use all your resources, and STUDY at least 7 days out of the exam. I would recommend her! Don't be too scared of this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mrs. Arnosky is the best professor I've had since coming to TAMU. She actually cares for her students and wants us to succeed. Her lectures are engaging and I walk out actually understanding the material. HIGHLY recommend.

This class is test-based. Arnosky is great at lecturing and doesn't assign a lot of work outside the class, so it's up to you how much you put into learning the concepts. SI helped me tremendously along with doing the extra practice problems she gave. Accounting can be hard if you don't put in the effort to practice it, getting an A is very doable

Accounting 229 can be very difficult because of the amount of topics you have to know, but professor Arnosky does a great job at explaining the concepts. While the 80% of your grade comes from tests, she gives you plenty of tools to succeed. Also, the accounting help desk is extremely useful and will help you understand the material better.
Absolutely horrible professor, has the most boring lectures and just works through problems without teaching them. I'll never forgive her for making me feel like I'm not smart enough.

This course is difficult not because each topic is hard to understand, but because there is so much you have to know. However, Professor Arnosky does a great job of breaking down each chapter for us. Although attendance isn't mandatory, you must show up to lecture to pass this class. As long as you constantly practice, an A is definitely attainable

i got a b but it's 100% possible to get an a. i got a 94, 90, and 74 on the tests (some personal stuff at the time) and needed a 94 on the final to get an a (yeah no). 80% of ur grade comes from tests/final so it's very unforgiving. GO TO SI!!! no need for tutor john if you put in the work weekly. arnosky is a good and caring professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is going to be hard, regardless of the prof. She did a great job covering the material, especially considering how dense it was at times. She likes when you ask questions, and she explains things really well so don't be afraid to! Reading textbook/going to SI isn't necessary, but can be helpful. Do practice exams and questions in Canvas!

Professor Arnosky is a great teacher, the class is just difficult for lots of people to do well. The class is very daunting, but not as bad if you read the textbook, do the practice problems, go to class, and go to SI sessions. The third test is the hardest and the final is MC. Get help in the beginning if you are struggling
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 229 just sucks as a class... she's a decent prof just tends to overdo stuff sometimes for certain questions. knoop was the one who made our exam review videos and i think it was easier to learn from her tbh. exams suck you gotta study 1 week in advance to really excel. everything else is easy. the exams do make up most of the grade.

Arnosky is a great teacher, but her class is not very forgiving. You will need to attend every lecture and memorize many points, equations, and small details for each small topic.
She teaches through physical notes and you have to rely on friends in the class to let you see their notes if you miss class. So, her teaching style is not for everyone.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Guys,

This class is very hard. Go to Maystutors and you will be fine. They teach you how to master this class. You have to practice alot outside of lectures, but professor arnosky does a great job, but maystutors helps you take acct 229 tests and succeed in this class. I got an A+ with maystutors definitely worth it!
Hard class.

Professor Arnosky is one of the best professors I have ever had. The subject material is very tough, but she did a great job in her lectures and as long as you attended class and took notes in the packets she gave us, you were good to go. This class is very challenging, but Professor Arnosky did a great job with the material.

She's a very simple professor who's just asking you to put in the effort to make a good grade. She explains all the concepts quickly in order to cover everything, but always makes time to answer questions in and out of class. Help desk was more helpful than the SI sessions, b/c SI just became a place to socialize.

Arnosky is a great prof! She really cares about her students understanding the content and is very honest about harder chapters. Her teaching style is easy to follow, and if you have questions, don't hesitate to ask. Do not skip class (acct is hard); if she says don't use your phone in class and you do, she will probably call you out.
GO TO SI. People who say they don't understand accounting are just lazy and do not put in the work. Just go to SI, its not that hard of a class then what people say!!!!

This class felt like a weed-out, but as long as you went to her lectures, did the homework, and went to SI sessions an A was feasible. She was a really fun professor but strict, so stay on top of your work. The tests are an important part of your grade, but the questions are mostly from her lectures so be sure to practice. Thankfully, no cumulative

ACCT 229 is just a hard class for any professor to lecture, but I think Prof Arnosky does as good as you can do. I recommend acct229dotcom its just really solid videos you can speed up and I learn best from that. After I started it, my next test went up 20+ points. Quizzes are done outside of class and are easy 100s if you go to help desk
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, Mays needs more teachers like Arnosky. She's truly the best teacher I've had in the building. If you enjoy a slower-paced class where the teacher walks you through everything you need to learn, she's your gal! I appreciated her never making us feel dumb for not knowing already and she's always up for helping.
Best professor!! So caring and nice I would definitely take another class with her again!

Prof Arnosky was a tough teacher for Acct 229. You will have to commit a lot of time to the class to do well. She isn't a bad teacher, but she could have been more clear with what would be on the test or provide more study materials.

Arnosky was a good teacher and I learned a lot. However, the class was very difficult and you have to really start studying before. I studied by reading and working through the notes and doing the practice problems. GO TO SI!! It helped me a lot and you get more practice.

Arnosky really cares about her students and this class is just overall difficult no matter who you get. She is very responsive, but the class size makes it somewhat difficult to talk to her during class. We seem to rush through the material too. Start studying early and youll be fine.
229 is just a hard class overall but she cared about us and really wanted us to learn the material

Professor Arnosky is very caring when it comes to her students. Although the class itself is difficult, she works hard to teach the material in an understandable way. The class is test-heavy, so make sure to study for each exam about a week in advance. I recommend taking this class in person with her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ended up Q dropping this class. This class is less which professor you take but how difficult the class is. The exams are very difficult & are worth 80% of your grade. Even with a tutor, going to the help desk, getting 100's on every assignment other than the exams, & doing the extra credit it still wasn't enough to pass the class. Good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Arnosky is a solid choice for accounting 229. She is available outside of class and gives amazing lectures that include hints about test questions. If you memorize the handouts and do the practice problems and exams you should do well. Compared to the other teachers she is more of a cool teacher, whereas Ms. Knoop is more of a mom teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's an amazing professor - very helpful and understanding of students. It's a difficult class though - make sure to study study study, and take full advantage of the help desk and office hours. You can also find the textbook online and use it for practice problems. Good luck.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is such a sweet professor, I would definitely recommend her. Yes, the tests are hard but they are the same ones for all ACCT 229 students and I found that Prof Arnosky was very helpful in explaining concepts. 10/10
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very helpful professor. She gives her personal phone number to every class in case we have questions. Overall, course is not too bad, as long as you study a little. Weekly quizzes. A few homework assignments. Two exams. A practical over excel and access.

Arnosky is not only a great professor, but she is also kind and understanding. The class is hard and so are the tests, but her lectures are very helpful and clear. Definitely would recommend choosing her as your accounting 229 teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's good at explaining the material and answering questions. She gives opportunities for extra credit and takes the higher of two attempts for quizzes. The exams are a majority of your grade, but she provides practice tests, so they're easy to prepare for. The class isn't too hard if you put in the effort to practice the questions she gives you.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved Prof Arnosky!! I took this class online in the summer and ended up really liking learning via the videos! Arnosky is very sweet and genuinely cares about helping you learn the material. Your grade in this class will reflect the amount of time you put into assignments and studying, so you should be good as long as you put in the effort.

This is a review of her summer ACCT229 online class. Prof. Arnosky is probably the most accessible professor I have ever had. She let us text her personally about any questions we had up until the later evening, every day. She is incredibly caring and I wouldn't have passed the class without her extensive help. I highly recommend her.

Mrs. Arnosky seemed like she really cared about her students. I took this class over the summer so it was all online. The lecture videos were pretty good. The tests were fair. If you studied the notes, you should be fine. If you hate math though, this class won't be all that fun. I didn't use the textbook, so I wouldn't spend your money on it.

Mrs. Arnosky's class is hard because she's not a very good teacher. Granted, she's not bad, but her explanations dont really click or make sense sometimes which is terrible for a lecture heavy, limited practice, only graded by tests/quizzes accounting class! I ended up purchasing access to an accounting website online and passed through that lol.

Arnosky's a pretty good prof. She's very sweet and really tries to look out for her students, both academically and personally. She's very easy to reach outside of class. Lectures were easy to pay attention to. BUT this class is SUPER hard. You can't just show up to class and expect an A. Study hard for tests, go to SI, and try and read the book.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Arnosky was not the prof that I originally wanted when I signed up for this class but I am so glad I had her. She's my favorite prof so far at A&M. She went through Mays and so she is very relatable. I found it easy to learn from her and she truly cares about her students. This is a hard class but she does everything to help.I highly recommend her.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Arnosky is a great teacher. I am in her 229 class this spring and her class had the highest test averages over all of the other professors for the first exam. 229 is a very difficult class so be prepared and go to tutoring. But, I believe she had a transitional period when coming to A&M as a young professor. However, I absolutely recommend her

Ms Arnosky is a great professor, but the class is hard no matter what. They dont curve in this class, despite it being one of the fail out courses at Mays. Test averages are always Fs and even if you do well above the test averages, youll still get a poor grade. She teaches well, but the grading is brutal.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Arnosky is super sweet and cares a lot about her students. However, she teaches her class like they already know the material even though it is an intro class. Concepts were not explained well. I went to every lecture, went to tutoring, etc. and still did not come out with a good grade and I had all As before this class. 229 is just hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Shes really great. The class is hard no matter what. But she cares for her students and provides the resources for you to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Arnoksy is the best! she is very caring and wants you to suceed! if you do not understadn what is going on get help immediately. i cannot stress that enough, study everyday, do the practice probelms and practice exams! you have to get ready to work hard, study hard, and work smarter!!! she is the best to go with! truly wants the best 4 u

She was a really nice professor, but she barely explained things. I basically taught myself and got a lot of outside help. For me, Knoop's test reviews were suppppperrrr helpful! I also went to tutor john! As long as you do a lot of practice tests and problems, you should be fine.

Very sweet professor she is a new teacher which makes it pretty difficult considering how hard this class is. Study! Study! Study! Seek outside tutoring if needed understanding everything is crucial to pass this class. This class is very hard and needs time invested daily if you want to do well. There is a project, weekly quizzes, and exams..

ACCT229 is a difficult class no matter what. However, she is a solid choice for your prof, as she cares about her students and will help you if you have questions. Study hard, do extra problems, go to the review sessions, and you will do fine! Don't skip class or you will have no idea what you are doing.

229 is hard no matter who you have. Study hard and go to office hours and you should do ok on tests. DO THE EXTRA PROBLEMS! Doesn't do a great job of explaining lectures beyond what's on the notes, so go to SI sessions & Knoop's test reviews to clear things up. Final was ok. Overall not terrible, but if you can take Knoop I would recommend that.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Arnnosky is a very nice lady, but Acct. 229 was the toughest class I have taken at A&M. She did lecture alot, but did not explain the material very well. She also taught material as if students had background knowledge of accounting. Again, she was a very nice professor, but did not always successfully teach the material in a helpful way.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mrs. Arnosky was a very nice professor but did not teach the material very well. She taught the material like students had background knowledge of accounting when the majority did not since it is an intro class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mrs. Arnosky is one of the sweetest professors I have had. However, I did not feel like her lectures were very helpful when it came time to take the exam. She reads directly off of the notes and does not provide a lot of extra information behind what she is reading, which can be an issue, especially if you have no prior background in accounting.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Arnosky genuinely cares for her students success and understands that the class is hard so she goes out of her way to help. She gives good lectures and makes sure the class understands before moving on. Participating in lectures helps a lot and the textbook isn't required but reading it and doing the extra problems are good supplement.
